laws.name: Only chain-shortening pays
laws.detail: weight-stationary smem residency 0.91x, deep K-rings, FA2-style pipelining, MPK prefetch, register-resident reuse — all measured slower in the 8-warp regime; wins came from fusion, register feeds, boundary removal, banding

laws.name: One register point
laws.detail: 256 threads x 255 regs = the 64K regfile exactly; every add-warps design pays fat-path registers; nvjet routes per family across register points, the megakernel cannot

laws.name: Wave quantization
laws.detail: 132 blocks = one wave; tile counts quantize to 132; banding wins iff band tiles stay near <=132 or total work >> one wave
